name: legal-auditor-ai
description: Contract clause classifier: fine-tuned LegalBERT on CUAD, 88.4% accuracy on unseen contracts. Streamlit app with risk flags, explanations and PDF reports.

paragraphs: Legal Auditor AI takes a contract (pasted text or a PDF), splits it into clauses and classifies each clause with a fine-tuned LegalBERT model into one of 19 clause types (Governing Law, Limitation of Liability, Anti-Assignment, Audit Rights, ...) or Other. Each clause gets a risk level and the words that influenced the prediction most.

It then asks the opposite question: which clause types should be in this contract and are not? A distribution agreement with no Limitation of Liability and no Audit Rights is unusual, and that is a finding no per-clause label can express. "Unusual" is measured, not assumed — against the base rates of the 510 annotated contracts, within the same contract type where there is enough data for one.
The labels come from CUAD, a public dataset of 510 commercial contracts annotated by lawyers.
